player_prompt.intro:
Ansuf yiswen s Lights Out! Ɣur-k {size}x{size} taɣzut n tifawin.
Tigzi-k d aɣzaf akken ad tfawet akk tifawin (yetwakksent s yal « . »).
Mikwentel tafawt, ad tɛeddi iman-is d tifawin tijen i yellan deffir-s (sufell/ wadda/ ayfus/ azelmaḍ).
Irzi [row col] i wakken ad tekwentel tafawt (0-indexed, ihi anagraw amahbul d 0-{max_index}).
Ɣur-k alamma d {max_turns} n tikliwin i wakken ad tesleḍ takliwt.
Asalen: 'O' = tafawt yetwakksen, '.' = tafawt yetwaffa

board.current_state:
Asaleḍ n waddad aɣelnaw (Aseɣzu {moves_made}, {moves_left} n tkeččayin yettwafren, {completion}% yettwakksen):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Taɣawsa ilaq ad tili deg uḍris [row col] anda tazelɣa d usekles llan s imdanen seg 0 ar {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Izwalen ilaqen ad illin gar 0 d {max_index}. Tekkiḍ [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Ayyuz! Tfeḍ-d tamsirt s {moves_used} n yiberdan !
